prompt:
Create ONE high-fidelity Turkish appointment-management UI draft board, not a production screenshot. Inherit the attached approved management screenshot's exact world: cream #FFECD1, navy #001524 body/heading text, petrol #15616D navigation, orange #FF7D00 primary buttons with NAVY text, brown #78290F feedback; Unna serif ONLY Randevu wordmark, system sans for all task UI. No logos, photos, avatars, charts, calendars, shadows or nested cards. This is the next small section inside the already approved product, not a new identity or design alternative tournament.

Landscape board about 1792x1200. LEFT two wide readable desktop workflow excerpts stacked, labeled outside the UI '1 · PERSONEL LİSTESİ' and '2 · SEÇİLİ PERSONEL'. RIGHT a narrow tall mobile detail viewport labeled 'MOBİL'. They show successive states of ONE list-to-detail flow, not alternative concepts. Include an external small footer 'TASLAK · İsimler örnek veridir; sunucuya bağlı değildir.'

Top LEFT desktop LIST viewport: established cream header Randevu, İşletme sahibi, Çıkış yap; narrow petrol group rail with İşletme, Ekip selected, Hesap and Değişiklik kayıtları near bottom; cream contextual drawer Ekip, Personel selected, Çalışan erişimleri. Main heading Personel. Short note 'Personel kayıtları giriş hesabı oluşturmaz.' Single orange 'Yeni personel' primary near title. Plain rows separated by fine rules, no individual cards or portraits. Columns 'Ad soyad', 'Durum', and action. Exactly THREE synthetic rows: 'Örnek personel' / '● Aktif' / outlined 'Ayrıntılar'; 'Diğer örnek' / '● Aktif' / outlined 'Ayrıntılar'; 'Pasif örnek' / '○ Pasif' / outlined 'Ayrıntılar'. Only ONE action per row. Footer secondary 'Listeyi yenile', 'Önceki sayfa', 'Sayfa 1', 'Sonraki sayfa' (previous and next muted for this example). No total count, search, filters, service counts or statistics; existing API does not provide them.

Bottom LEFT desktop DETAIL viewport is the same working surface, can show cropped main content with the header/sidebar continuation simplified to keep task legible. At top outlined 'Personel listesine dön'. Main category title Personel then selected identity 'Örnek personel' and plain written status '● Aktif'. Three horizontal task navigation controls: 'Bilgiler' selected with petrol underline, 'Hizmetler', 'Saatler'. Treat these as three views of the same selected record, not three separate popups. Under selected Bilgiler: visible label 'Ad soyad (zorunlu)', standard full-width input 'Örnek personel', orange 'Adı kaydet' with navy text and outlined 'Vazgeç' side by side. Separate thin-rule section 'Personel durumu', explanation 'Pasifleştirme kaydı silmez. Giriş hesapları etkilenmez.', outlined secondary 'Pasifleştir'. This action requires a separate confirmation in implementation; don't render a toggle or combine it with name save. Do not show fake success message or claim saved values. The view may show a small brown draft sentence 'Değişiklikler henüz kaydedilmedi.' as a clearly deliberate unsaved state, but omit it if input equals initial identity.

RIGHT MOBILE shows same selected DETAIL layout on cream: top Randevu / outlined Menü; sidebar closed. Full-width back action 'Personel listesine dön', heading Personel, identity Örnek personel with ● Aktif. Three compact equally readable horizontal controls Bilgiler / Hizmetler / Saatler (Bilgiler selected), each at least 44px touch height. Visible Ad soyad (zorunlu), input Örnek personel. Orange Adı kaydet and outlined Vazgeç STACKED. Then thin-rule Personel durumu section, same truthful explanation and full-width outlined Pasifleştir. Natural vertical flow, no blank bottom void. Preserve 48px controls, 16px text, 6px corners and fine borders. Desktop/main headings use clear sans hierarchy, no giant promotional headings.

Add one short scope caption OUTSIDE the viewport: 'Hizmetler: mevcut seçimler ve aktif/pasif kuralları. Saatler: onaylı haftalık düzen.' Do not illustrate those two tabs as different visual concepts or add new API actions. Correct Turkish labels, no browser chrome or device frame. Make all three views readable with generous efficient spacing matching the reference.
scope: T03 personnel list and selected-record detail; desktop/mobile
origin: One draft board showing successive list and detail states within the inherited management design. Synthetic names; no real API or implementation proof.
userPreference: Avoid additional image and native review rounds; reuse the approved management identity.
approval: T03 taslak sunumundan sonraki Onaylıyorum yanıtı görseli ve ayrı ekran kodu kapsamını onayladı; 04.10.2026.
